_readme: OPTIONAL: ClinePass key-router provider entry for the factory user's ~/.pi/agent/models.json (merge under 'providers'). Point model entries in repo configs at provider 'clinepass-rotator' and the router on the VPS (src/keyrouter.ts, port 8099) fans your ClinePass API keys (state/clinepass.keys, one per line) behind a single endpoint — weekly caps fail over automatically. host.docker.internal must resolve on the HOST (bootstrap adds 127.0.0.1 host.docker.internal to /etc/hosts) and via host-gateway inside containers (fallback mode adds it; compose mode uses extra_hosts). Model ids/costs below mirror ClinePass's catalog — adjust to what ClinePass actually serves you.
